title: Clocked body action
statement: Given an action for a machine with $k+1$ work tapes, form an action on the clock simulation states that preserves its input-head movement, work-tape instructions, and output symbol. Its successor state is the decrement state in the run phase carrying the original successor state when that state exists, and the finish state carrying no body state when the original action halts.
